prior_results_seen: PR257 192 synthetic common-clock q-calibrated fixed trained predictor rankings already inspected; under correct 4h q time scope 16/24 or 17/24 pairwise fixed-sample signs robust, not population site confidence. This new test estimates probability of A score > B at a fresh independent physical site, conditional on trained models, source camera q time structure, and the same 82 matched dates.
scientific_estimand: P_unseen_physical_site[fixed-trained model A has GREATER observed-event conditional heldout 96 CIVIL-bin logscore per event than fixed-trained B, over the SAME original 82 days] > 1/2, not mean logscore superiority, causal phase or latent animal activity.

sampling.heldout_unit: An independently sampled PHYSICAL SITE with ALL 82 date records; never treat 82 date observations, 96 time bins or individual events as new independent sites.
sampling.simulation_identity: REPLAY EXACT original PR257 reference CP calibration, original simulated detected animal count tensor and frozen peak estimates via odsp.uljin_96bin_simultaneous_q_calibration_v0 helper functions. NO new seed or favorable resampling; parent first source code and result ledger unchanged.

error_allocation.site_exact_test: For each site i, compute exact SHARP minimum over the SAME source q box of its logscore gap D_i(q), with fixed trained A,B and original civil 96 bins. K=sum_i 1{min_q D_i(q)>0}; one-sided exact Binomial(16,1/2) tail P(X>=K) tests H0 P_new_site[D_i(true q)>0]<=1/2. For true q inside independently calibrated BOX, conservative robust-positive count K<=true positive count. No normal approximation or bootstrap for n=16.
error_allocation.per_scenario_multiplicity: Four hypothesis tests each at .00625. The 192 source-free design cases are diagnostic mechanism worlds, NOT jointly claimed 5% across all 192, and different model-truth worlds may share the same random synthetic observations.

temporal_source_scope.q_true_4hour_constant: CP confidence interval for source 4h q can transport to original quarter-hour detection when calibrated camera q truly CONSTANT within all six original 4hour blocks for each day.
temporal_source_scope.q_true_within_block_variation: Exact CP confidence for source 4h average q does NOT cover actual fine-grained 15min q; HOLD_TIME_RESOLUTION_NOT_ADMISSIBLE for ALL coarse 4h-based tests, irrespective of observed CP interval width or positive site count.
temporal_source_scope.fine_96bin_valid_scope: Exact source q reference CP intervals are correctly specified for every original quarter-hour cell in BOTH frozen synthetic q worlds.
temporal_source_scope.coverage_leak_prevention: Whether true q was contained in the ACTUAL randomly sampled CP reference interval is an ORACLE outcome audit only, NEVER a prerequisite for an inferential label. Selection based on realized coverage is infeasible in real research and breaks nominal coverage interpretation.
temporal_source_scope.zero_lower: Any source q group with 0 lower bound yields HOLD_UNKNOWN_DETECTOR_Q. No pseudo-counts.

algorithm.heldout_site_score: Each site's same-civil-bin conditional 96bin event logscore gap normalized by that site's whole 82-day detected event count; all physical sites receive equal site weight.
algorithm.shared_q: For each of 82 dates, detector q is common across all 16 HELDOUT sites and both competing models, and may differ by date. One q box is optimized *jointly* for the log normalizer ratio, not separately per candidate. Site-specific robust lower D_i(q) uses shared per-day fractional-linear optima; no inner q fitting from wildlife outcomes.
algorithm.fractional_extrema: Use PR256's exact 65-bisection linear-fractional ratio extrema after summing each block's 16 original civil bins for 4h calibration; use all 96 original bins for fine q.
algorithm.strict_positive: A site is robust-positive iff lower logscore gap > 1e-12. Ties/ambiguous sites are counted NOT robust-positive.
algorithm.tail_threshold: With 16 independent sites, one-sided alpha=.00625 requires at least 14 robust-positive site scores; exact P[Binom(16,.5)>=14]=137/65536 approx .0020904541. 13 robust-positive sites is NOT enough: 697/65536 approx .010635.
algorithm.familywise_null: P_site-majority null applies to each fixed ordered forecast pair, not global five-family model selection. Per-scenario four-test Bonferroni and independent source detector coverage union bound yields 5% false certification under the specified independent physical site, fixed training, and correct time-scope model.
algorithm.oracle_diagnostics: Compute K_true using true 96bin q only to assess false noncoverage; never use it for decisions. All source-free cal q coverage and whether K_robust<=K_true when covered must be reported.

Oracle CP coverage must NOT be used as an admission/decision rule. It is unknown at application time; future valid confidence guarantees would be selected dishonestly if conditional on seeing true q coverage.
No independence inflation: 16 physical heldout sites, not 82 days or 96 response bins, are trial count n in sign test.
Guard reference calibration and heldout q sources are independently sampled; genuine original wildlife counts/time slices remain unavailable.
Four pairwise tests alpha_site_each=.00625 and simultaneous q coverage alpha=.025, with per-scenario union bound ≤.05 under correct source detector temporal calibration scope.
Individual site robust lower score bound uses SAME q shared by all compared models and sites on a day.

If CP intervals not jointly containing real true q (in synthetic oracle diagnostic), procedures still execute WITHOUT oracle outcome gating; mathematical noncoverage is paid by calibration .025 budget.
Block coarse detector q is banned from 96bin inference under within-block temporal heterogeneity even though averaged q CP coverage is valid.
End result cannot claim statistical confidence in expected population logscore difference, endogenous photoperiod memory, or causal zeitgeber.
